<thought>We need retrosynthetic templates for two key disconnections: (1) formation of a sulfonamide from a sulfonyl chloride and an amine, and (2) formation of an amide from a carboxylic acid (or its activated form) and an aniline. We'll search the template catalog for each transformation using appropriate functional group or bond criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
